root_cause.summary: No page emits a dead slug. Every guard-passing dead click is a REAL product id with text glued onto the URL path, so resolveProductId fails and the worker returns 404 (x-mcp-buy: unknown-product) and counts it as buy.unknown-product (no ?src survives).

patterns: CJK answers by an AI assistant: URL followed with no space by full-width punctuation, autolinker swallows it, e.g. /buy/work-order（買い切り, /buy/bill-of-sale。このサーバー単体は, /buy/packing-list（一次性付费）... (21 of 25 counted)

root_cause.caveat: The counted-shape dead clicks carry sec-fetch-site: none together with Referer https://mcp.zovo.one (origin only), Windows UA, mostly US IPs. A typed or pasted navigation sends no Referer, so this shape is more consistent with an AI agent browser following its own answer than with a person. Treat as demand of unknown nature, not buyers.
root_cause.measurement_note: Valid products count a click only on the checkout POST, while the unknown branch counts the GET. 32 of 35 compares GET navigations against checkout submits; it was never like-for-like.
